one_liner.zh: 为 DSH 提供 GitHub 协作工具和 Web 工作台
one_liner.en: GitHub collaboration tools and a web cockpit for DSH

accounts: GitHub account authenticated with GitHub CLI (gh auth login)

external_services.purpose: GitHub repository, pull request, issue, Actions, release, and other collaboration operations

local: A local Git workspace is used for repository-aware operations; web routes are available when the DSH webServer service is present

skipped: Most tool implementation modules under src/tools/ (including PR, issue, Actions, release, secret, skill, label, ruleset, cache, gist, status, agent-task, discussion, project, and Codespaces handlers), remaining API route groups and UI components; reviewed exported registration declarations and excerpts only for these areas.

completeness.reason: Entry point registers 19 task and domain tools, optional slash commands and web routes; the task tool covers review, CI diagnosis and release preparation.

code.reason: Typed configuration and modular tool registration are paired with structured task envelopes, budget truncation and tier filtering.

docs.reason: README sections cover installation, authentication, tool usage, UI, configuration and development.

maintenance.reason: 167 commits and a push recorded on 2026-11-05 indicate frequent recent changes.

tests.reason: 53 test files and a CI workflow are recorded in extracted repository facts.

quality.notes: Quality dimensions for code and completeness are based on the entry point and core modules read; maintenance and test scores use extracted repository metadata.
